lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance, approximately circular pixel clusters arranged in four distinct horizontal rows posterior to the fifth gill slit.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Linear vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity that intersect with the horizontal rows of blobs, creating a grid-like spatial arrangement on the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal feature characterized by a sharp vertical gradient in pixel intensity, with high-luminance pixels on the dorsal side and low-luminance shadows on the ventral side, running parallel to the shark's longitudinal axis.

other_distinctive_markers: Multiple small teleost fish (pilot fish) with vertical banding are visible in the ventral water column and trailing the pectoral fin.
